uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-3097-3490-7492.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional creature that can be sacrificed by Ashnod's Altar and which will cause Arnyn to trigger.
2034-3097-3490-7492.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Arnyn triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

3389-4050-5043-7824.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Faerie tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7725.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Selfless Police Captain.
When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2654-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Shark Typhoon
1618-2440-2654-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Shark Typhoon triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2654-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Shark Typhoon. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

339-677-2292-4460.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1232-1270-5477-7297.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

2191-2510-7070.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2191-2510-7070.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Monk Gyatso.
Activate Monk Gyatso by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
Monk Gyatso's ability from step 4 fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat from step 2.

539-5147-7037.description:
Cast Toph by paying its mana cost
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

30-147-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-147-6798.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Storm of Souls.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Storm of Souls
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-147-6798.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

2173-3967-5010-5708.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

465-3967-6132.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1562-2921-4375.description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Machine God's Effigy enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Machine God's Effigy.
Resolve the Machine God's Effigy trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Machine God's Effigy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1661-5078-5645.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1580-4871-5111-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1796-2908-3682-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2281-5231-6598.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting General Leo Cristophe.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing General Leo Cristophe.
When General Leo Cristophe dies, Saffi triggers, returning General Leo Cristophe from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When General Leo Cristophe enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4681-4894-5147-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

requires.n: Instant or Sorcery that costs {B}{B} or less

1031-1170-2701--74.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the additional instant or sorcery and putting it into your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying at most {B}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the additional instant or sorcery.
Repeat.

2525-5147-6132.description:
Cast Metamorphosis Fanatic by paying {4}{B}{B}.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Double.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Body Double, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

184-3129-3883.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
184-3129-3883.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and create two Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1636-2857-2897.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
1636-2857-2897.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Gigantoplasm.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Gigantoplasm into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Gigantoplasm to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

4186-4279-4476.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-4476.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Answered Prayers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

654-1993-3478-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Budoka Gardener.
Budoka Gardener does not have summoning sickness.
You control eight or less lands.
654-1993-3478-3525.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.

682-4499-4929-5296.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Supply Runners.
When Supply Runners enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

1494-1991-2744.notablePrerequisites: Tana has power five or greater, does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1494-1991-2744.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tana.
Tana triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
When the Saprolings enter the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers that many times, putting that many +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

678-944-1718.description:
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Catalyst Elemental by paying {R}.
Repeat.

2470-2645-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Staff of Domination to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Grand Architect's first ability by paying {U}, causing Staff of Domination to become blue until end of turn.
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping Staff of Domination, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead tap Staff of Domination using its other abilities if it does not have summoning sickness.

2034-3433-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hornet Queen, adding {C}{C}.
When Hornet Queen dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Hornet Queen from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Hornet Queen enters, it triggers, creating four creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3478-3525-4348.notablePrerequisites:
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Ley Druid.
3478-3525-4348.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
